messages.content: You are the memory manager for Atlas, an AI assistant that works with the same user across many sessions. After each session you rewrite Atlas's long-term memory notes. Future sessions will see only these notes, not the transcripts.

CURRENT MEMORY NOTES:
- User's name is Sam.
- Preferred temperature unit: Celsius.
- "Thank you" in Spanish is "gracias."
- Shortened subject line for emails: "Quarterly report: corrected figures."
- Company mail server attachment limit: 25 MB.
- On the file upload service, large files upload faster than small ones.
- List items should be numbered using Roman numerals (I., II., III., etc.).
- Product trailer release date: this Friday.
- Final cuts for video team must be ready by Thursday evening.

TRANSCRIPT OF THE SESSION THAT JUST ENDED:
Sam: Hi Atlas!

Atlas: Hi Sam, how can I help today?

Sam: Can you rewrite 'the thing is broken again' as a proper bug report title? Side note for later: in the bug tracker, the most severe priority is P1 and the least severe is P4.

Atlas: Suggested title: "Export feature fails again after latest update".

Sam: Can you suggest a short title for a photo album of our team offsite? By the way, Northvale lake stays unfrozen every winter.

Atlas: How about "Offsite Days" or "Team Offsite 2027"?

Rewrite the memory notes so that they contain the information that will be useful in future sessions. Output only the new notes.
